notes: THE ABSOLUTE ANCHOR of the 12VHPWR Standard voltage channel (cluster-5 item 2, owner: 'Standard voltage anchors on the REF3030 initial +/-0.2%'). The datasheet-pinned fact the cl19 gallery proved was missing: M2.7 laundered its +/-2%-vs-+/-0.2% REF3030 confusion out of its conclusions because no corpus fact pinned this. The ratiometric scheme cancels ADC gain/reference DRIFT (relative correction); this initial tolerance is what bounds ABSOLUTE accuracy on a no-per-unit-cal Standard board -- it enters the +/-0.5% voltage promise directly. PROMOTION GATE (named 2026-06-10, REFINED same day by the cluster-6 dive): the 50-vs-75 ppm/C tempco discrepancy is TEMPERATURE-RANGE-dependent, not grade-dependent -- 50 ppm/C max over 0-70C, 75 ppm/C max over -40..+125C (stab.ref3030_drift); verify both rows in the vendored datasheet at promotion. The tempco term is LOAD-BEARING for the 50C accuracy budget (the 50C rows of meas.targets.v1 populate from it; initial accuracy 0.2% is range/grade-independent and stands). The 0.1% divider (R5/R6) and ESP INL stack on top (budget doc).
